einzeiler: A book-loving assassin enters a deadly 13-week competition to win her freedom in a glass…
kurzfassung: Celaena Sardothian, a notorious 19-year-old assassin imprisoned in brutal salt mines, is pulled into a high-stakes tournament by the crown prince of Adarlan. Competing against 24 champions for the position of the king's personal assassin, she navigates dangerous court politics, unexpected friendships, and emerging magical mysteries. As brutal murders occur within the castle walls, Celaena begins uncovering ancient secrets connected to the glass fortress and her own destiny.
stichpunkte: Celaena Sardothian is pulled from the Endovier salt mines by Captain Chaol Westfall to compete as Prince Dorian's champion.
The competition features 24 diverse contenders, including elite soldiers, brutal murderers, and thieves, with one eliminated each week.
Celaena adopts the alias Lillian Gordana to hide her true identity as a famous assassin from the court.
She forms a bond with Crown Prince Dorian over a shared love of reading and exchanges language lessons with the foreign princess Nehemia.
Several competitors turn up brutally murdered with their brains and innards missing, escalating the tension in the castle.
During the second trial, a climbing challenge, Celaena rescues a fellow competitor named Nox from falling after another contestant sabotages his rope.
Celaena experiences vivid dreams where she explores hidden castle tunnels and encounters ancient historical figures like Queen Elena.
She wakes from a mysterious dream with a physical amulet given to her by an ancestral spirit, confirming that magic and ancient threats are returning.

clips.hook: An imprisoned 19-year-old assassin who is already formidable from the start
clips.text: The hosts introduce the protagonist as an imprisoned teenage killer who stands out from typical fantasy heroines by being dangerous and capable right from the beginning.

clips.hook: A terrifying murderer who kills people with a completely unexpected weapon
clips.text: The speakers discuss the colorful nicknames and bizarre murder methods of the dangerous criminals participating in the deadly royal tournament.

clips.hook: The world's greatest assassin loses her composure over a little laughter
clips.text: The host points out a contradiction in the main character's supposed expertise, noting that the most famous killer in the world reacts impulsively when mocked.

clips.hook: Competitors keep getting torn to ribbons and left without brains
clips.text: The speakers recap the escalating body count in the tournament as yet another participant is brutally slaughtered inside the castle.

clips.hook: A magical dream leaves behind a physical object in the real world
clips.text: The host expresses confusion over how a spectral encounter inside a vision resulted in the protagonist waking up holding a physical amulet.
